title: Carboxylate-Decorated Aggregation of Octanuclear Co4Ln4 (Ln = Dy, Ho, Yb) Complexes from Ligand-Controlled Hydrolysis: Synthesis, Structures, and Magnetic Properties

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear Co4Ln4 aggregate of two partial-dicubane Co2Ln2 units

synthesis.procedure: General one-pot route for 1–3: to H2L (1 mL, 0.1 mmol) in MeOH were added Ln(NO3)3·nH2O (0.1 mmol) in 2 mL MeOH and NEt3 (55.6 μL, 0.4 mmol) to give a clear solution. After 1 h stirring at room temperature, Co2-Piv (0.0474 g, 0.05 mmol) in 2 mL MeOH was added dropwise, producing a faint precipitate. The orange mixture was refluxed for 5 h at 70–80 °C. The filtrate was left for slow evaporation, giving rhombus-shaped orange crystals after 3 days. For 1 the lanthanide salt was Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (0.0438 g, 0.1 mmol).
synthesis.temperature: stirring at room temperature (1 h), then reflux at 70–80 °C
synthesis.time: 1 h stirring then 5 h reflux; crystals after 3 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: one-pot solution synthesis with reflux, then slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtrate from the reaction mixture kept for slow solvent evaporation to afford X-ray quality rhombus-shaped orange crystals after 3 days

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility shows ferromagnetic CoII–DyIII coupling within the Co4Dy4 core. Complex 1 is a zero-field SMM (Ueff = 12.5 K). Room-temperature χT = 66 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 68); Curie constant 66 cm3 mol−1; Weiss constant −2.13 K; magnetization 28 NμB at 2 K and 5 T.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1 using the general protocol, substituting Ho(NO3)3·5H2O (0.0441 g, 0.1 mmol) for Dy(NO3)3·5H2O. H2L (1 mL, 0.1 mmol) in MeOH with NEt3 (55.6 μL, 0.4 mmol) and Co2-Piv (0.0474 g, 0.05 mmol); 1 h stirring at room temperature then 5 h reflux at 70–80 °C; crystals by slow evaporation after 3 days.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtrate kept for slow evaporation to give rhombus-shaped orange crystals after 3 days

properties.summary: Dc data indicate ferromagnetic CoII–HoIII coupling and a low-T χT upturn. No SMM behavior is reported for 2. Room-temperature χT = 64 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 68); Curie constant 64 cm3 mol−1; Weiss constant −1.99 K; magnetization 28 NμB at 2 K and 5 T.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1 using Yb(NO3)3·6H2O (0.0467 g, 0.1 mmol) in place of Dy(NO3)3·5H2O. Same ligand/base/Co2-Piv amounts, 1 h room-temperature stirring, 5 h reflux at 70–80 °C, and crystallization by slow evaporation after 3 days.

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility is consistent with four CoII and four YbIII ions and a ferromagnetic low-temperature χT increase. No SMM behavior is reported for 3. Room-temperature χT = 20 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 22); Curie constant 20 cm3 mol−1; Weiss constant −2.12 K; magnetization 15 NμB at 2 K and 5 T.
